Apply for a PhD project in GGNB
You wish to do your PhD in the Göttingen Graduate Center for Neurosciences, Biophysics, and Molecular Biosciences? Apply now! We have no application deadlines and PhD projects in our center can start throughout the year.
Exception: the integrated MSc/PhD programs Molecular Biology and Neurosciences (deadlines: 15 January). For details see their websites.
For general information on earning a doctorate at Göttingen University, see this page.
You are eligible to apply to GGNB if:
a) you have already secured a doctoral position with a GGNB faculty member. You have to apply within 3 months after the start of the PhD project, however, we strongly recommend that you apply before or immediately after starting your PhD position in order to process your application, admission and enrollment as soon as possible. In your application, make sure to include a confirmation by the supervisor that he/she has offered you a PhD position (see page Application process);
or
b) you have successfully established contact to a GGNB faculty member who has expressed an interest in your application and who may be able to offer you a PhD position if you pass the selection process. You may apply up to 3 months before the possible start of the PhD project.
Make sure to include a statement by the faculty member who is interested in your application and may be able to offer you a PhD position, including details on funding and a preliminary project title. Important: without this statement, we will not be able to process your application.
For details on how to apply, see the page Application process.
